item.question: What role do inclination angles play in determining Doppler shifts?
item.answer: Inclination angles determine how multipath signals interact with an antenna's motion vector, influencing whether they experience positive or negative frequency shifts. These angles help define geometric structures like cones that describe possible frequency changes.
